directive_events.owner_directive: Plan: token-file helpers + lifespan-free arming context manager in api/routes/webmcp.py (written by the default guard's build only while the launching CLI arms it; removed when uvicorn.run returns; never written under a replacement guard); serve/gui wrap uvicorn.run with it (uvicorn.run arguments unchanged); new cli/webmcp_adapter.py (hand-rolled newline-delimited JSON-RPC over stdio, httpx client to /api/webmcp/tools and /call, project snapshot, stale-context list_changed, bearer or token-file credential, bounded startup wait, bounded logging, --print-config). Spec 4 adapter section + CHANGELOG.

docs_events.rationale: The ADR-055 section 4 amendment named in #2308 is outside this dispatch's write set (docs/adr is not assigned); the adapter adds no registry and no server transport, so ADR-055 section 4's rule holds unchanged. Reported to the manager.
Spec 4 (adr-055-enterprise-support) already specifies FR-008 to FR-011; this change fills in its adapter section.

owner_directive: Manager dispatch (umbrella #2321, O2): implement ADR-055 Spec 4 open-source FR-008 to FR-011 - a stdio MCP adapter over the WebMCP HTTP bridge (scistudio webmcp-adapter) plus the per-user loopback token file written with the default guard only (owner option B, 2026-09-11).
